material_limits.source_limitations_policy: An explicit empty source limitations string means no source-specific limitation was recorded. It is not evidence of unrestricted service; all sealed category, season, tariff and future-operation uncertainties remain applicable.
material_limits.temporal: Catalogue identity read25Oct2026 does not refresh property evidence read19–20Oct. Original publication/read/document-season fields remain intact; no validity period or expiry is invented. Exact travel-date room/tariff/service/availability remains unverified.
unknowns: The retained official rule is16+ from2025, not18+ and not historical2024 policy; adult tariff labels do not override property admission. A Family name does not admit children under16.
Standard30m2 double+single has no published numerical maximum; Family35m2/two bedrooms/double+3single does not establish five permitted guests, closed doors or child-age tariff.

Official SwimUp25m2 and Fibula SwimUpStandard25m2/max2 are a source-scoped published association, not universal tariff-code equivalence, proof of quietness or current availability. Fibula Summer2025 context does not override official16+ with conflicting child labels.
The parallel top500 research key is a possible duplicate kept separate; no new physical hotel, ID merge or extra independent corroboration is claimed. Vox Maris Grand Resort in Romania is distinct.

Guest swim-up shade/noise reports, beach-shuttle intervals, sea entry, winter heating and paid UAI/restaurant exceptions are outside this group. Empty source limitations fields do not remove general future-operation uncertainty.
